description: Manjaro 26.0 with the KDE Plasma desktop. Arch Linux made approachable: a rolling release with the AUR at your fingertips, tempered by Manjaro's own testing buffer and graphical tooling for kernels and drivers.

maintainer.note: Catalog-only entry: the install plugin is not written yet. Note: Manjaro does not ship a signed shim — Secure Boot must be disabled.
